changelog:
Initial release of GitX, a portable Git workflow skill for AI coding agents.

- Provides smart commit creation with logical commit grouping and Conventional Commit messages
- Supports branch creation with contextual naming and safe switching
- Includes commands for status inspection, commit planning, scanning for secrets, and repository history visualization
- Enables safe pull, push, GitHub pull request, and issue integration
- Assists with merge/rebase conflict resolution and running relevant project checks before commits
- Designed to clean up and organize AI-generated file changes for use with Agent Skills-compatible coding agents
summary: Smart Git workflows and secret scanning
